Here’s a classic, well‑balanced ingredient list for a moist, chocolate‑rich cake that’s perfect for birthdays, parties, or a cozy dessert at home. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras (like espresso powder or sea salt) to suit your taste. | Ingredient | Quantity | Notes | |------------|----------|-------| | **All‑purpose flour** | 2 ½ cups (≈312 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb. | | **Cocoa powder** | ¾ cup (≈75 g) | Unsweetened, Dutch‑processed or natural—just keep the same type throughout. | | **Granulated sugar** | 2 cups (≈400 g) | Gives sweetness and helps with browning. | | **Brown sugar** | ½ cup (≈100 g) | Adds moisture and a hint of molasses flavor. | | **Baking powder** | 1 ½ tsp | Leavening agent. | | **Baking soda** | 1 tsp | Works with the acidity of cocoa and buttermilk. | | **Salt** | 1 tsp | Enhances flavor. | | **Eggs** | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsion. | | **Buttermilk** | 1 cup (≈240 ml) | Adds tang and keeps the cake tender. | | **Whole milk** | ½ cup (≈120 ml) | Balances the buttermilk’s acidity. | | **Vegetable oil** | ½ cup (≈120 ml) | Keeps the cake moist; can substitute with melted butter for richer flavor. | | **Vanilla extract** | 2 tsp | Classic flavor enhancer. | | **Boiling water** | 1 cup (≈240 ml) | Activates cocoa, creates a silky batter. | | **Optional extras** | | • 1 tsp espresso powder (boosts chocolate flavor)
• Pinch of sea salt (balances sweetness)
• ½ cup chocolate chips or chopped nuts (for texture) | ### Quick Tips - **Sift dry ingredients** together first to avoid lumps and ensure even distribution of leavening agents. - **Mix wet and dry separately** before combining; this prevents over‑mixing and keeps the batter light. - **Add boiling water last**—the batter will look lumpy but will become smooth once mixed. - **Bake at 350 °F (175 °C)** for 30–35 minutes (check with a toothpick). - **Cool in the pan for 10 min**, then transfer to a wire rack to finish cooling. Enjoy your chocolate cake! If you’d like a frosting recipe or variations (e.g., vegan, gluten‑free), just let me know.
